blocks.text: ECHAGUE, ISABELA, Philippines — Anti-Pax Silica tarpaulin banners displayed at two universities in Isabela were taken down within minutes of being put up on Tuesday, Nov. 17. This, amid farmers and youth groups voicing continuous opposition to the United States-led international initiative that will be set up in Capas, Tarlac, citing concerns over human rights, food security and the displacement of farming communities. “The photographs speak about the possibility of agricultural lands being replaced by the Pax Silica industrial hub and the threats to food security, jobs and the lives of Filipinos—not only in Capas, Tarlac, but also in Isabela and […]...
